skill.name: youtube-transcript
skill.description: Extract subtitles from YouTube videos with yt-dlp, clean VTT captions, and prepare transcript text for summaries and chapters.
skill.summary: Extract YouTube subtitles and clean them into transcript text for summaries, chapters, and keyword review.

security_audit.summary: Static hits are Markdown fences, inline code markers, visible yt-dlp examples, one setup command, and a placeholder YouTube URL. No evidence found of prompt injection, hidden data exfiltration, unauthorized privilege escalation, or malicious intent in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Keep sudo package installation as a manual prerequisite and require explicit user approval before any elevated install command runs.

remediation.issue: User-provided video URLs are passed to external tools
remediation.suggestion: Validate that URLs are intended YouTube targets and keep them quoted when constructing yt-dlp commands.

remediation.issue: Whisper fallback can download audio and consume local resources
remediation.suggestion: Continue requiring confirmation before audio download or transcription, and state expected storage, bandwidth, and processing cost.

content.user_title: Extract YouTube Transcripts for AI Summaries
content.value_statement: Video transcripts are hard to collect and clean by hand. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through subtitle extraction, cleanup, and summary preparation.
actual_capabilities: Lists available subtitles for a YouTube video with yt-dlp.
Downloads manual subtitles in selected languages when they exist.
Falls back to auto-generated subtitles when manual captions are unavailable.
Cleans VTT files by removing timestamps and blank lines.
Uses extracted text to create summaries, chapters, and keyword lists.
limitations: Requires yt-dlp, and optional Whisper support must be installed separately.
Depends on subtitle availability, video access, and network permissions.
Auto-generated captions can contain errors, duplicates, and missing speaker context.
Audio download and Whisper transcription require user confirmation and extra processing time.

use_cases.title: Lecture Review
use_cases.description: Extract captions from educational videos, then produce a concise summary and chapter outline.

use_cases.title: Content Research
use_cases.description: Turn public video captions into searchable notes for topic analysis and quote discovery.

use_cases.title: Localization Prep
use_cases.description: Download available subtitle languages and compare transcript coverage before translation work.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the English transcript from this YouTube video: [URL]. Clean the text and tell me if captions are unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Lecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Download the transcript for [URL], remove VTT timestamps, and create a concise summary with main concepts and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Subtitle Languages
prompt_templates.prompt: Check which subtitle languages are available for [URL]. Extract English and Korean captions, then summarize differences in coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: For these YouTube URLs, extract available transcripts, deduplicate repeated captions, identify key themes, and produce a source-by-source research brief.

output_examples.input: YouTube lecture URL with English captions.
output_examples.output: A cleaned transcript, a five-point summary, and a chapter list with estimated timestamps.

output_examples.input: Video with only auto-generated Korean captions.
output_examples.output: A deduplicated Korean transcript plus a note that captions were automatically generated and may need review.

output_examples.input: Two videos about the same topic.
output_examples.output: A comparison brief with recurring themes, unique points from each video, and keywords for follow-up research.

best_practices: Confirm the video URL and requested subtitle language before running commands.
Prefer manual captions before auto-generated captions.
Ask for user approval before downloading audio or running Whisper.
anti_patterns: Do not run installation commands with elevated privileges without explicit user approval.
Do not assume auto-generated captions are accurate enough for citation.
Do not download audio when normal subtitles are available.

faq.question: What does this skill extract?
faq.answer: It extracts available YouTube subtitles and prepares clean transcript text.

faq.question: Does it download the video?
faq.answer: It uses subtitle-only workflows first. Audio download is only for Whisper fallback after user approval.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. yt-dlp needs network access to query YouTube and download subtitle files.

faq.question: Can it handle multiple languages?
faq.answer: Yes, when YouTube provides those subtitle tracks. It can list available languages first.

faq.question: What happens if no subtitles exist?
faq.answer: It can suggest Whisper transcription after confirmation, but that takes more time and local setup.

faq.question: Is transcript quality guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Manual captions are usually better, while generated captions may have errors and duplicates.
